items.title: 20.2 Nomenclature of Benzene Derived Compounds (benzene se bane compounds ke naam) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 20.2 with Quick Check 20.2 answered, printed pages 59-61.

blocks.text: Jin aromatic hydrocarbons ke structure mein sirf ek benzene ring ho, unhein monocyclic aromatic hydrocarbons kehte hain. Pehle hum monocyclic aromatic compounds ke nomenclature (naam rakhne ka tareeqa) dekhenge. Benzene derivatives ke naam do tarah rakhe jate hain: ek mein naam ke aakhir mein 'benzene' aata hai, aur doosre mein benzene nahi aata (special name, khaas naam).
Jab benzene par sirf ek substituent (H ki jagah laga group) ho to use monosubstituted benzene kehte hain.

items: Zyada tar monosubstituted benzenes ka naam 'benzene' ko base name bana kar aur substituent ko prefix (naam ke shuru mein) laga kar rakha jata hai, jaise chlorobenzene, nitrobenzene aur methyl benzene.

Bohat se monosubstituted benzenes ke common (aam) naam hain; in mein se kuch IUPAC ne base name ke taur par maan liye hain, jaise phenol, toluene, aniline. Neeche bold mein likhe common names IUPAC ke mutabiq sahi base names hain. Monosubstituted benzene mein substituent hamesha C-1 par hota hai, is liye us ka number likhne ki zaroorat nahi.
Kuch benzene derivatives ke khaas naam hain jo IUPAC naam ke taur par accepted (maane hue) hain, jaise benzene carboxylic acid, benzene sulphonic acid.

blocks.alt: Nau benzene rings, har aik par aik substituent, kitab ke naamon ke saath: toluene (methylbenzene), phenol (benzenol), anisole (methoxybenzene), aniline (benzenamine), benzaldehyde (benzenecarbaldehyde), benzoic acid (benzenecarboxylic acid), benzene sulphonic acid, nitrobenzene aur chlorobenzene.
blocks.caption: Common names of monosubstituted benzenes (kitab ke PDF page 62-63 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Jab benzene ring par do substituents hon to unhein disubstituted benzenes kehte hain. In ke naam neeche ke rules (qaidon) se rakhe jate hain.

items: Jis carbon par zyada priority (tarjeeh) wala substituent laga ho woh C₁ hai; baqi carbons us se aage number hote hain. Priority ka order (left se right, zyada se kam): -COOH, -CN, -CHO, -COCH₃, -OH, -NH₂, -OR, -R
Agar dono substituents ki priority barabar ho to jis substituent ka naam alphabet mein pehle aata hai, us ka carbon C₁ hota hai.

blocks.text: Neeche ki misalein dikhati hain ke disubstituted benzenes ke naam kaise rakhe jate hain.

blocks.alt: Teen disubstituted benzenes, ring ke carbons par number: 3-hydroxybenzoic acid (C-1 par COOH, C-3 par OH; acid ki priority alcohol se zyada), 4-isopropylphenol yani 4-(1-methylethyl)-phenol (C-1 par OH, C-4 par isopropyl; phenol ka alcohol C-1 hai), aur 1-bromo-2-chlorobenzene (C-1 par Br, C-2 par Cl; alphabet mein bromo chloro se pehle).
blocks.caption: Names of disubstituted benzenes (kitab ke PDF page 63 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Did You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Disubstituted benzenes ke common names do substituents ki aapas ki position (jagah) se bante hain. Ring par numbers ki jagah ortho- (o-), meta- (m-) ya para- (p-) likh sakte hain: ortho yani 1,2 (saath wala carbon), meta yani 1,3 (ek chhor kar), para yani 1,4 (bilkul saamne).

blocks.alt: Teen dibromobenzenes, ring ke carbons 1 se 6 tak number: C-1 aur C-2 par Br, ortho (1,2); C-1 aur C-3 par Br, meta (1,3); C-1 aur C-4 par Br, para (1,4).
blocks.caption: Ortho, meta aur para positions of benzene (kitab ke PDF page 63 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki teesri ring (C-1 aur C-4 par Br) ke saath 'ortho (1,3)' likha hai. Positions 1 aur 4 para hain, is liye sahi label para (1,4) hai; yahan diagram mein sahi label hai.
Jin aromatic hydrocarbons ke molecule mein do ya zyada benzene rings hon, unhein polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons kehte hain, jaise naphthalene (C₁₀H₈), anthracene (C₁₄H₁₀) aur phenanthrene (C₁₄H₁₀).

blocks.alt: Naphthalene, do jure rings (C10H8); anthracene, seedhi line mein teen rings (C14H10); aur phenanthrene, angle (kone) par jure teen rings (C14H10), ke Kekule structures.
blocks.caption: Example of polycyclic benzenes (kitab ke PDF page 63 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).
blocks.long_description: Polycyclic arenes mein parosi rings aik C-C kinara baant'te hain. Anthracene aur phenanthrene ka formula aik, C14H10, hai lekin un ke rings alag alag tareeqe se jure hain: seedhi qatar mein aur zaviye par.

blocks.text: Neeche ke arenes ke naam batayein:

blocks.alt: Chhe arenes, i se vi: (i) benzene jis ke C-1 aur C-3 par NO2; (ii) do parosi carbons par Cl; (iii) OH aur Br aamne saamne (para); (iv) CH3, us ke saath wale carbon par Cl aur saamne Cl; (v) CH3 aur teen NO2 groups, do parosi aur aik saamne wale carbon par; (vi) benzene par C(=O)-O-CH3.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 20.2 ke arenes (kitab ke PDF page 64 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.prompt: Upar bane chhe arenes (Quick Check 20.2) ke naam batayein.

items: Monosubstituted: substituent + benzene, ya IUPAC mein accepted common naam (toluene, phenol, aniline).
Disubstituted: zyada priority wala group C₁ par; ortho (1,2), meta (1,3), para (1,4).
Polycyclic: do ya zyada rings, jaise naphthalene, anthracene, phenanthrene.
